name: Yiggite Preacher Snakeskin
text:
To better spread their faith among humans, sekmin Yiggites disguise themselves in these enchanted serpentfolk snakeskins. The snakeskin functions as a set of Moderate Cloister Robes with the following additional activation.

Activate—Change Shape 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

---
Effect You cast a 3rd-rank Humanoid Form on yourself. The spell lasts for 8 hours, until you fall Unconscious, or until you Dismiss the effect, whichever comes first.

---
